fix: Borrow instead of cloning the whole theme struct: `let default = ComponentThemeData::default();` then `let inherited = inherited.unwrap_or(&default);`. Every field read below is Copy (Option<f32>, Option<Color>, Option<EdgeInsets>, Option<BorderRadius>, Option<Clip>, Option<Border>), so `inherited.x` reads through the reference without moves. Only `style` (ButtonStyle, heap-carrying) is dropped from the clone.

Clone only the shared cells the dismiss path needs, not the whole DialogHandle (which deep-clones the Dialog descriptor, including its Option<String> semantic_label and Widget). Move the set_open body into a free fn `fn set_open_cells(open: &Cell<bool>, revision: &Cell<u64>, value: bool)` that does the replace/revision bump, then build the barrier with `let open = Rc::clone(&self.open); let revision = Rc::clone(&self.revision);` and `on_click(move || set_open_cells(&open, &revision, false))`. Minimal alternative: move `let dismiss = self.clone();` inside the `if self.barrier_dismissible` branch (still clones Dialog in the dismissible case).
